meta.description: File index for Codesidekick Mothership — includes purpose and key exports

src/lib/config/projects.ts.purpose: Master project manifest — single source of truth for all tracked projects
src/lib/config/projects.ts.notes: Add new projects here only. Downstream routes auto-adapt.

wrangler.toml.purpose: Cloudflare Pages worker config — bindings, compatibility, KV namespaces
wrangler.toml.notes: Worker name: pm-arigato. KV_INVOICES bound with real namespace IDs.

.env.example.purpose: Environment variable template — copy to .env and fill values

src/app.d.ts.purpose: Global TypeScript declarations — KVNamespace interface, App.Platform with AI+KV_INVOICES bindings

src/lib/types/invoice.ts.purpose: Invoice domain types — Invoice, LineItem, InvoiceStatus, computeTotals(), newInvoiceId()

src/lib/types/ccs.ts.purpose: CCS agent types — CCSSnapshot, CCSPhase, CCSTask, CCSExecution, GitCommit, CCSReviewIssue

src/lib/stores/settings.ts.purpose: Persisted user settings — BYOK keys, AI routing, integrations, appearance

src/lib/stores/projects.ts.purpose: Svelte store wrapping project manifest for reactive access

src/lib/integrations/asana.ts.purpose: Asana API adapter — server-side only. Fetches and normalises project tasks.

src/lib/integrations/shopify.ts.purpose: Shopify Admin API adapter — store meta, themes, recent orders

src/lib/integrations/invoices.ts.purpose: Invoice CRUD via Cloudflare KV (KV_INVOICES) with in-memory Map fallback for local dev

src/lib/integrations/ollama.ts.purpose: Local LLM client for iMac Ollama server (10.0.0.45:11434). Used for summarization and daily briefings.

src/routes/+layout.svelte.purpose: App shell — sidebar navigation, project list, responsive layout

src/routes/+page.svelte.purpose: Dashboard home — active project cards, daily briefing, activity feed

src/routes/+page.server.ts.purpose: Dashboard server load — passes project manifest to client

src/routes/settings/+page.svelte.purpose: Settings UI — AI providers (BYOK), integrations, appearance, data export/import/reset

src/routes/forge/+page.svelte.purpose: Forge project dedicated page (Shopify theme for Zebra Skimmers)

src/routes/projects/[slug]/+page.svelte.purpose: Dynamic project detail page — tasks, integrations, AI chat, GitHub feed

src/routes/projects/[slug]/+page.server..purpose: Server load for project detail — fetches Asana, Shopify, CCS agent data based on manifest config

src/routes/projects/new/+page.svelte.purpose: Multi-step project intake form — 4 steps: basics, stack, goals, integrations

src/routes/projects/new/+page.server.ts.purpose: Form actions — AI-generated project brief + tasks via Anthropic API, exports ccsConfig JSON

src/routes/api/anthropic/test/+server.ts.purpose: POST /api/anthropic/test — validate Anthropic API key (1-token ping). CORS proxy for browser.

src/routes/api/chat/+server.ts.purpose: POST /api/chat — project-aware AI chat using Anthropic (claude-sonnet-4-5, max 2048 tokens)

src/routes/api/invoices/+server.ts.purpose: POST/PUT/DELETE /api/invoices — invoice CRUD backed by KV_INVOICES

src/routes/api/ollama/brief/+server.ts.purpose: POST /api/ollama/brief — generate 3-paragraph daily briefing via local Ollama

src/routes/api/ollama/summarize/+server..purpose: POST /api/ollama/summarize — summarize activity events into a short paragraph via local Ollama

Dockerfile.purpose: Multi-stage Docker build for Coolify self-hosted deployment (node:20-alpine, port 3000)

.github/workflows/deploy.yml.purpose: CI/CD — deploy to Cloudflare Pages on push

.github/workflows/ci.yml.purpose: CI — run svelte-check and type validation

docs/project-persistence.md.purpose: Architecture doc — KV storage patterns and project persistence design

src/app.css.purpose: Global CSS — Tailwind base, CSS custom properties for project accent colors

logs/.gitkeep.purpose: Placeholder to preserve logs/ dir in git
